settings.heading: Original Art for Spaces
settings.text:
We are open for commissions for hotels, restaurants and private collections.

No posters. No prints. Every Soumkine is a unique original — signed, dated, one of one.
settings.statement: Need 30 unique paintings for 30 rooms in one language? We do that.

settings.title: For 10, 50 or 100+ rooms
settings.text: Each room gets its own original. No duplicates.

settings.title: Palette matched to your interior
settings.text: We work from your moodboard, Pantone or brand book.

settings.title: On time for your fit-out
settings.text: Palette proposal in 48h, production schedule you can actually plan around.

settings.heading: Art that makes guests stay longer.
settings.text: We create series for rooms, corridors and lobbies. Every piece is unique, but they share one visual language — so the hotel feels coherent, not decorated.
settings.note: I know your side: before painting full-time, I spent 9 years leading marketing and development for a group of Paris hotels. I know what a guest photographs first.

settings.title: One wall, one language
settings.text: From a single large 160 × 160 cm (63″) piece to a series for multiple dining rooms.

settings.title: Custom palette
settings.text: We match your wood, textiles, brand colors. The painting looks like it was always there.

settings.title: Originals only
settings.text: Thick acrylic texture, signed, one of one. Guests feel the difference between art and a print.

settings.title: Made in our Paris / Brussels atelier

settings.heading: The wall your guests will Instagram before the menu.
settings.text: A restaurant needs atmosphere, not decoration. We paint originals that set the tone — warm, calm or electric — and match your brand palette exactly.
settings.cta_label: Get a palette for your restaurant

settings.title: Commission your palette
settings.text: Tell us your wall, light and mood — we propose 3 palettes.

settings.title: Statement formats
settings.text: 120 × 120 cm (47″), 160 × 160 cm (63″), 200 × 200 cm (79″) — the scale that makes a living room.

settings.title: Signed, dated, unique
settings.text: No posters, no prints, no second edition. Ever.

settings.heading: One wall. One original. One of one.
settings.text: For collectors and private homes. We create a single statement piece for your space — painted to your interior, but still 100% Soumkine.
settings.note: I work in tandem with the machine: I design the composition and lay the paint; the machine carries the brush. That’s how you get a large, precise original without waiting 6 months.

settings.heading: Start a commission
settings.text: Tell us about your space: walls, light, palette, timeline. We’ll come back with a proposal.
settings.success_text: Thank you. We’ll be in touch shortly.
